## History

James A previously lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), and had fond memories of visiting Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) during his boyhood. After his sister—who used to keep house and spoil him—passed away, he eventually separated from his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), following a dispute over his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md). [Emily](../character/emily.md) returned to her own house, insisting she would only stay with him if he got rid of the bird.

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)_
